name: Denali National Park
policyReason: The pets page opens the Roadside Hiking Trail and Roadside Bike Trail to leashed pets, so trails, not roads.
summary: Leashed pets may walk the Roadside Hiking Trail and Roadside Bike Trail, plus roads, parking lots and campgrounds.

excerpts.quote: The exceptions to this rule are the Roadside Hiking Trail and the Roadside Bike Trail, where they may be walked on leash.
In general, pets are not permitted on park trails

dogRules.text: Leashed pets may use the Roadside Hiking Trail and Roadside Bike Trail.
Working sled dogs allowed Oct 1 to Apr 14.
